title: CovidNow SARS-CoV-2 Assay rRT-PCR Batch Set Up
author: Opentrons
materials: Samples will be put into the 384 well plate in the following manner: * `96 Well Plate Type`: Specify whether using the four 96 plates as the Kingfisher plate (depth 12.8mm) or the thermofisher plate (depth 42.3mm). * `384 Well Plate Type`: Specify whether using the 384 plate with the clear numbers, or the 384 plate with the black numbers. Plate should be mounted on aluminum block. * `Use Temperature Module?`: Specify whether using the temperature module or not on the 384 plate in slot 3 for this run. The temperature module will be set at 4C. If not using the temperature module, just place the 384 plate in slot 3 with no aluminum block. * `P20 Multi-Channel Mount`: Specify which mount (left or right) to host the P20 Single-Channel pipette. ---

steps.title: Prepare plate layout and load slots
steps.instruction: Determine the number of samples. Load the four 96‑well source plates onto the robot in slots 7, 8, 1 and 2 respectively (plate 1 → slot 7, plate 2 → slot 8, plate 3 → slot 1, plate 4 → slot 2). Choose the 96‑well plate type (KingFisher depth 12.8 mm or ThermoFisher depth 42.3 mm) and the 384‑well plate type (clear‑numbered or black‑numbered) and mount the 384‑well plate on an aluminum block. If a temperature module is used, place the 384‑well plate in slot 3 on the module and set the module to 4 °C; otherwise place the plate in slot 3 without a block. Select the P20 multi‑channel mount (left or right). For a full run (382 samples) the robot will automatically dispense master mix into wells O24 and P24; leave wells H11 and H12 on the final plate (slot 2) empty. For a non‑full run, add master mix and controls manually according to the layout.

steps.title: Dispense PCR master mix (first column)
steps.instruction: Using the 8‑channel pipette, attach eight 20 µL filtered tips. Aspirate 15 µL of PCR reagent from the designated well of the 12‑well reservoir and dispense into the first column of the 384‑well plate (wells A1‑H1). Perform a blow‑out and touch‑tip before discarding the tips.

steps.title: Fill remaining master‑mix wells
steps.instruction: Repeat the dispense operation for each subsequent column of the 384‑well plate until all designated wells (including O24 and P24 for a full run) contain 15 µL of master mix. Use fresh 20 µL filtered tips for each column, performing blow‑out and touch‑tip each time. Discard tips after the final column.

steps.title: Transfer first column of samples
steps.instruction: Pick up a new set of eight 20 µL filtered tips on the 8‑channel pipette. Aspirate 5 µL of sample from the first column (A1‑H1) of 96‑well plate A (elution plate or KingFisher deep‑well plate). If using a deep‑well plate, position the tips at the dead centre of each well. Use touch‑tip after aspiration. Dispense the 5 µL into the corresponding wells A1‑H1 of the 384‑well plate, perform a blow‑out, then discard the tips.

steps.title: Transfer remaining sample columns of plate A
steps.instruction: For each subsequent column of 96‑well plate A, repeat the aspirate‑dispense cycle: pick up fresh 20 µL filtered tips, aspirate 5 µL from the column (touch‑tip, centre of deep‑well if applicable), dispense into the matching 384‑well column while **skipping one column** on the 384 plate between additions, perform blow‑out and touch‑tip, then discard the tips. Continue until all samples from plate A are transferred.

steps.title: Transfer samples from plates B‑D
steps.instruction: Repeat the entire column‑by‑column transfer (aspirate 5 µL, dispense into the 384‑well plate with a one‑column skip, blow‑out, touch‑tip, discard tips) for 96‑well plates B, C and D in that order. Ensure that wells P22 and P24 on the 384‑well plate receive only master mix and **no sample**.
